name: create_invoice
description: Create a new draft invoice for a customer. It is not sent until send_invoice is called.

parameters.unit_amount: number, required. Price of one unit

name: list_invoices
description: List invoices, optionally filtered by status.

parameters.status: string, optional. One of DRAFT, SENT, PAID, CANCELLED

name: get_invoice
description: Get the details of one invoice.

name: send_invoice
description: Send a DRAFT invoice to the customer for the first time.

name: send_invoice_reminder
description: Send a payment reminder for an invoice that was already SENT and is not yet paid.

name: cancel_sent_invoice
description: Cancel an invoice that was already SENT and is not yet paid.

name: record_payment_for_invoice
description: Record a payment received outside the platform against a SENT invoice.

parameters.method: string, required. One of BANK_TRANSFER, CASH, CHECK, OTHER

name: generate_invoice_qr_code
description: Generate a QR code the customer can scan to pay an invoice.

name: get_order
description: Get the details of one order.

name: create_refund
description: Refund a captured payment. Needs the capture ID of the payment, not the order ID. Leave out amount_value to refund in full.

parameters.amount_value: number, optional. Only for a partial refund

name: get_refund
description: Get the details of one refund.

name: list_disputes
description: List customer disputes, optionally filtered by state.

parameters.dispute_state: string, optional. One of REQUIRED_ACTION, UNDER_REVIEW, RESOLVED

name: get_dispute
description: Get the details of one dispute.

name: accept_dispute_claim
description: Accept a dispute in the customer's favour, which refunds the customer. Only for disputes in REQUIRED_ACTION state.

parameters.note: string, required. Short note to the customer

name: list_transactions
description: List transactions between two dates.

name: create_shipment_tracking
description: Add shipment tracking details to an order.

parameters.carrier: string, required. One of UPS, FEDEX, DHL, USPS

name: get_shipment_tracking
description: Get the shipment tracking details of an order.

name: show_subscription_details
description: Get the details of one subscription.

name: cancel_subscription
description: Cancel an ACTIVE subscription.

name: list_subscription_plans
description: List the merchant's subscription plans.

name: create_product
description: Create a new product in the catalogue.

parameters.name: string, required
parameters.type: string, required. One of PHYSICAL, DIGITAL, SERVICE

name: list_products
description: List the products in the catalogue.

name: show_product_details
description: Get the details of one product.
